items.title: Multiplication by a power of f identifies the cohomology of M up to f-power torsion with the cohomology of eta_f M
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The statement concerns a ring A with a nonzerodivisor f, a complex M of f-torsion free A-modules, and the shifted complex eta_f M whose i-th term is f^i M^i; it asserts that multiplication by f^i induces a canonical isomorphism from the quotient of H^i(M) by its f-torsion subgroup onto H^i(eta_f M) (statement lines 27493-27501). The proof is short but it carries the two computations that make the isomorphism canonical: the cycles of the shifted complex are identified with f^i times the cycles of M using injectivity of multiplication by f on the terms, and the kernel of the resulting surjection is computed by cancelling a factor f^{i-1} from the equation f^i z = d(f^{i-1} y), which is exactly the point at which the nonzerodivisor hypothesis is used (proof lines 27503-27514). The counted span is self-contained: it refers to no labelled item of the chapter and cites nothing.
